source.source: TUMFTM/racetrack-database minimum-curvature reference line, pinned at e59595d1f3573b30d1ded6a08984935b957688e0

reference.averaging: Pedal, speed, and yaw-rate channels are resampled by normalized lap distance and averaged across the fastest valid laps.
reference.lapDistanceSource: MoTeC distance channel or speed-time integration

carParameters.units: Ratios normalized to the GT-R reference car; set from each car’s ACC 1.10 BoP and setup.

adjustmentModel.brakingDistance: inversely scales with brakePerformanceRatio / massRatio, with a bounded downforce contribution
adjustmentModel.cornerSpeed: scales with sqrt(downforceRatio / massRatio), bounded to +/-15%
adjustmentModel.straightSpeed: scales with sqrt(powerRatio / massRatio), bounded to -20%/+20%
adjustmentModel.accelerationDistance: scales with sqrt(massRatio / powerRatio), bounded to -30%/+40%
adjustmentModel.note: First-order guidance only; validate against each car’s telemetry and ACC 1.10 BoP.

warnings: The selected GT-R logs do not contain measured GPS/world coordinates. The shared line is the bundled track-reference line, not a GT-R driver trace. Supply logs with measured position channels to extract and average the GT-R line.
Per-car ratios are configurable first-order estimates; validate each car against ACC 1.10 BoP and telemetry.
